response.sql: WITH race_averages AS (SELECT raceId, AVG(CASE WHEN points > 6.0 THEN points END) AS avg_points, AVG(CASE WHEN points > 6.0 THEN wins END) AS avg_wins FROM constructorStandings GROUP BY raceId), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_wins) AS avg_wins FROM race_averages) SELECT r.raceId, r.avg_points, r.avg_wins, r.avg_wins - o.avg_wins AS difference FROM race_averages AS r CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE o.avg_wins IS NOT NULL ORDER BY difference IS NULL, difference DESC LIMIT 10
